API Documentation

Base URL: https://zenv-hub.onrender.com

Endpoints:

  • POST /api/auth/login - Authenticate
  • GET /api/packages - List packages
  • POST /api/packages/upload - Upload package
  • GET /api/packages/[name] - Get package info
  • POST /api/badges - Create badge

Zenv CLI Integration

Configure your Zenv CLI:

zenv config set registry https://zenv-hub.onrender.com
zenv config set token [your-token]

Documentation

Zenv Package Hub

A package repository for Zenv programming language.

Getting Started

1. Register an account on this hub

2. Generate an access token in Settings

3. Configure Zenv CLI with your token

4. Start publishing and installing packages!

Package Format

Zenv packages use .zv extension and follow this structure:

my-package/
├── package.zv
├── README.md
└── zenv.toml

CLI Commands

# Install Zenv CLI
pip install zenv-cli

# Publish a package
zenv publish ./my-package

# Install a package
zenv install my-package
